info.title: Kavach API
info.description: Browser → Hono only. Bootstrap CSRF with GET /session; create a guest session; send cookie, Origin and X-CSRF-Token on mutations. Reads/creates are owner-scoped. AI conversations and account login are not implemented. Idempotency keys expire after 24 hours. Revision checks are mandatory. Comparison changes must be nonempty; blocked tasks require a blocker and all other task states require null. CSRF/origin policy applies even where session creation has no account-login security requirement.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-kavach_session
sessionCookie.description: Production cookie; local development uses kavach_session. Both are HTTP-only.
